settings_modal.title: Settings
settings_modal.ipc_port_description: Port the GUI and CLI use to connect to the core daemon (1024–65535). Usually no need to change it.
settings_modal.ipc_port_restart_notice: Port change applies after the daemon restarts
settings_modal.console_buffer_description: Maximum lines kept in the server console
settings_modal.no_extensions: No extensions. Put extension folders in the extensions/ directory.
settings_modal.relay_url_description: Server-chan URL for cloud mode. Leave empty to use the default server.
settings_modal.auto_generate_passwords_description: Fills an empty REST password with a random one when the server starts. Existing passwords are not changed.
settings_modal.port_conflict_check_description: Shows a warning when several servers use the same port.
settings_modal.auto_port_check_description: When a server is created and when Saba-chan starts, checks through Server-chan whether it is reachable from outside. Closed ports are shown on the server page.
settings_modal.uninstall_description: Completely removes Saba-chan from this computer. Running servers are stopped cleanly first, then the installer runs in uninstall mode.
settings_modal.name_egg: No relation to a certain VTuber… I only found out after picking the name, and honestly, it's not fair.

about_intro.body: I'm the maid who starts, stops, and looks after your game servers when they're feeling unwell.
about_intro.sister_desc: She connects Discord to your PC

settings_modal.accent_color_description: Choose the color for buttons and highlights
settings_modal.backdrop_desc_mica: The desktop color softly tints the window
settings_modal.backdrop_desc_acrylic: What is behind the window shows through, blurred
settings_modal.backdrop_desc_macos: What is behind the window shows through like frosted glass
settings_modal.backdrop_desc_linux: What is behind the window shows through. Blur depends on the desktop environment
settings_modal.backdrop_unavailable_no_compositor: Only available on desktops with a compositor
settings_modal.backdrop_reopen: Applies when the window is opened again
settings_modal.backdrop_slow: This material may lag when dragging or resizing the window
settings_modal.backdrop_min_opacity: No blur here, so the minimum is {{min}}%
settings_modal.auto_refresh_description: Refreshes server status periodically. When off, it refreshes only when a screen opens
settings_modal.sidebar_compact_description: Narrower left list and tighter line spacing
settings_modal.console_wrap_description: Wraps long lines at the window width. When off, scrolls horizontally
settings_modal.console_auto_scroll_description: At the bottom, follows new lines
settings_modal.console_glass_description: When the window is translucent, the console background shows through too. When off, only the console stays opaque.
settings_modal.console_syntax_description: Color-codes server console logs by type
settings_modal.console_token_colors_description: Pick a color for each kind of console text. Unpicked kinds use the theme color
settings_modal.reset_theme_description: Restore all appearance settings to defaults
settings_modal.reset_gui_description: Restores GUI settings such as theme, colors, font size and refresh interval. Server and Discord settings are kept.
settings_modal.os_notifications_description: Also sends crashes and unexpected starts or stops as OS notifications. While the app window is in front, they show only in the app.
settings_modal.sound_effects_description: Plays a sound for starts and stops from outside the app (Discord, web, etc.), unexpected stops and start failures, abnormal exits of Saba-chan itself, install results, update discoveries, and normal startup (with the opening). Starts and stops done in the app are silent.
settings_modal.close_action_description: Action of the window close button
settings_modal.system_monitor_description: PC usage graphs on the server page. When off, no values are collected. The floating window can be dragged within the app
settings_modal.toast_duration_description: How long in-app notifications stay on screen
settings_modal.console_fonts_description: Pick a font for each script. Mixed-language lines use the matching font for each character.
settings_modal.console_timestamps_description: Show the received time before each console line
settings_modal.new_server_defaults_description: Values filled in when creating a server. Changeable per server afterward.
settings_modal.audit_keep_description: Activity records older than this are deleted automatically.

add_server_modal.title: Add New Server
add_server_modal.select_game_subtitle: Choose a game to set up your new server.
add_server_modal.provision_hint: Server files are downloaded automatically when added.
add_server_modal.no_modules: No modules. Get game modules at <link/>.
add_server_modal.preset_none_hint: Created with the game's default settings.
add_server_modal.preset_not_found: No such recommended setup in this module. Refresh modules and try again.
add_server_modal.platform_unsupported_detail: This game module runs only on {{platforms}}
add_server_modal.arch_unsupported_detail: This game module runs only on {{architectures}} CPUs
add_server_modal.version_hint: Only versions available for the selected server type are shown.
add_server_modal.location_default_hint: Installs into a folder Saba-chan creates per server. Deleted with the server.
add_server_modal.location_custom_hint: Installs into the empty folder you select. Its files remain when the server is deleted.
add_server_modal.folder_in_use: Server '{{name}}' already uses this folder. Choose another.
add_server_modal.folder_not_empty: This folder already has files. Choose an empty folder, or link an existing server with 'Import existing server'.
add_server_modal.folder_not_absolute: Enter the full folder path (e.g. D:\Servers\minecraft).
add_server_modal.run_managed_hint: Saba-chan manages the server process. Console, logs and auto restart are available.
add_server_modal.run_unmanaged_hint: Saba-chan starts the server and only checks whether it is running. The Saba-chan console is unavailable, and on Windows the server opens in a new console window.
add_server_modal.port_hint: Saba-chan picked a port no other server uses. You can change it.
add_server_modal.port_in_use: {{servers}} also uses port {{port}}. Running together causes a port conflict.
add_server_modal.port_reserved: Port {{port}} is reserved by Windows and cannot be used. Choose another port.
add_server_modal.checking: Checking for clashes with your other servers…
add_server_modal.check_failed: Port conflict check failed. It is checked again when adding.
add_server_modal.port_invalid: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535.
add_server_modal.folder_unavailable: Folder creation failed. Check the path and permissions.
add_server_modal.pick_subtitle: Which game server do you want to run?
add_server_modal.summary_subtitle: You can create it with the recommended values.
add_server_modal.detail_desc: Set server settings such as difficulty, max players and whitelist in advance.

migration_modal.title: Import Existing Server
migration_modal.description: Import an existing game server folder into Saba-chan
migration_modal.no_auto_detect: Game server auto-detection failed. Select a module below.
migration_modal.configure_subtitle: Name the server you are importing.
migration_modal.running_body: Stop it first. Running the same world from Saba-chan and elsewhere at once can corrupt it. If a scheduled task or startup program starts it automatically, turn that off too.
migration_modal.mode_link_desc: Files are not moved. If you later remove the server from Saba-chan, this folder remains.
migration_modal.mode_move_desc: Only within the same drive. Game data outside the server folder is not moved. Deleting the server in Saba-chan also deletes these files.
migration_modal.change_start_desc: Saba-chan starts the server directly instead of your start script.
migration_modal.change_start_undo: Your start script is not deleted
migration_modal.change_settings_desc: Game settings are read as they are. Values Saba-chan needs to manage the server, such as license agreement or remote console, may be changed.
migration_modal.change_settings_undo: Originals are kept and can be restored on removal
migration_modal.change_access_desc: Adds Saba-chan access permissions to this folder to run the server in isolation.
migration_modal.change_backup_desc: One backup is taken right after import. You can roll back to this point.
migration_modal.change_backup_undo: Removing it from Saba-chan also deletes its backups
migration_modal.benefit_console: View the console in the app and enter commands directly
migration_modal.benefit_discord: Friends can start, stop and run commands from Discord
migration_modal.benefit_settings: Edit server settings on a settings screen instead of files

server_settings.title: Settings
server_settings.protocol_single_only: This game is controlled only via {{protocol}}.
server_settings.no_settings: No additional settings in this module
server_settings.module_aliases_title: Module Aliases (Names to call this server on Discord)
server_settings.module_aliases_hint: Separate several aliases with spaces. e.g., {{module}} pw palworld
server_settings.command_aliases_hint: Separate multiple aliases with commas. e.g., start, begin, run
server_settings.version_description_install: Select a version and press Install to download the server files.
server_settings.branch_desc: Pick the same branch as your friends, or they cannot join.
server_settings.branch_notice: Re-downloads the server files from the selected branch and saves that branch. Later updates use the same branch. The world is kept, but it may not open after downgrading.
server_settings.version_hidden: {{count}} setting(s) missing in the installed version ({{version}}) are hidden
server_settings.reset_server_desc: Erases this server's data and returns it to its initial state. What is erased depends on the game. This cannot be undone.
server_settings.reset_settings_desc: Resets all server settings to defaults. World and save data are kept. This cannot be undone.
server_settings.reset_preview_desc: The items below will be deleted from '{{name}}'. This cannot be undone.
server_settings.stored_values_notice: Could not read the settings file, so the last saved values are shown. Saving applies only the fields you changed.
server_settings.install_server_running: Cannot install a version while the server is running. Stop it first
server_settings.reset_server_running: Cannot reset a running server. Stop it first
server_settings.instance_busy: Another task (backup or restore) is running on this server. Try again when it finishes
server_settings.settings_changed: This server's settings were changed elsewhere after you opened this window. Reopen it to see the new values, then save.
server_settings.install_started: {{game}} {{version}} install started. A backup is made first and restored if the install fails. Progress is in the server list.
server_settings.extension_required_for_install: Required extension(s) missing: {{extensions}}. Install from Saba Storage first.
server_settings.restart_pending: {{count}} changed setting(s) apply after a server restart: {{fields}}
server_settings.auto_update_hint: When a new version is out and nobody is online, Saba-chan stops, backs up, updates and restarts the server. If players are online, it only notifies.
server_settings.idle_stop_desc: Saves and stops the server after nobody has been online for the set time. Saves PC memory and power.
server_settings.idle_stop_minutes_hint: When nobody has been online for this long
server_settings.idle_stop_grace_hint: No stop for this long after the server starts
server_settings.idle_stop_unsupported: Unavailable: this game does not report player counts
server_settings.unresponsive_desc: Action when the process is alive but the server does not answer status checks
server_settings.unresponsive_minutes_hint: Counted as unresponsive after this long (from 5 min)
server_settings.install_backup_failed: {{file}} backup failed, so nothing was installed. Check disk space and .bak files in the same folder.
server_settings.install_kept_backups: Files that could not be restored kept pre-install copies: {{files}}

app_exit.confirm_message: How would you like to exit?
app_exit.confirm_detail:
Exit Interface: closes only the window. The daemon keeps running and reconnects automatically on reopen.
Quit All: exits everything, including the daemon.
app_exit.managed_warning_detail:
These servers keep running. When Saba-chan starts again, it reconnects to their consoles. While it is off, commands, auto restart and Discord notifications are unavailable.
Quit?

saba_storage.restart_required_message: Applying updates restarts the program. Continue?
saba_storage.bot_no_token: Discord bot updated. No token, so restart it manually.
saba_storage.updater_background: {{key}}: updater applying files in the background
saba_storage.module_busy: Another install or removal of this module is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
saba_storage.module_in_use: A running server uses this module. Stop the server before removing it.
saba_storage.extensions_enabled: Extensions used by this module enabled: {{ids}}

saba_storage.version_yanked_hint: Release withdrawn due to a problem. Cannot be selected.
saba_storage.version_excluded: {{count}} version(s) excluded because they need a newer Saba-chan ({{versions}})
saba_storage.version_none: No selectable version for Saba-chan on this PC

saba_storage.version_waiting_any: Changes to {{version}} after running servers stop.
saba_storage.version_pinned_note: Manually selected version. Automatic updates resume when a version newer than {{until}} is released.
saba_storage.version_unpin_message: Changes {{name}} {{kind}} right away to the newest available version ({{version}}), then updates automatically.
saba_storage.app_version_now_kept: Current {{current}} · Previous version {{previous}} kept on this PC

saba_storage.app_version_previous: Previous version kept on this PC
saba_storage.app_version_previous_note: Settings from before the update on {{when}} are restored too.
saba_storage.app_version_latest_held_hint: Selecting this returns to automatic updates. Not on this PC, so it will be downloaded.
saba_storage.app_version_older_note: Versions older than {{lowest}} cannot be selected. They are not on this PC, and Saba-chan does not download versions older than the current one.
saba_storage.app_version_none: No other selectable versions. The previous version is kept only from an update until the next one.

saba_storage.app_version_reverting_reopen: This window closes shortly, then Saba-chan reopens on the selected version.
saba_storage.app_version_unhold_message: Changes right away to the newest version ({{version}}), then updates automatically.
saba_storage.app_version_unhold_only: No newer version now. Updates automatically when one is released.

shell.commands_offline: Start the server to send commands.
shell.delete_stop_first: Stop the server to delete it

shell.daemon_tip_token_invalid: The daemon is running but rejects this app's connection key. It may have been started by another Saba-chan install. Quit that daemon, then restart the daemon here.
shell.bot_tip_running: Discord bot connected through Saba-chan cloud
shell.bot_tip_connecting: Bot started. Connecting to Saba-chan cloud
shell.bot_tip_stopped: Discord bot stopped. Click to go start it
shell.daemon_about: Service on this PC that runs servers and every feature
shell.risk_confirm: '{{command}}' is hard to undo. Run it?

shell.restart_on_crash_hint: When the exit was clearly an error
shell.restart_on_unknown_hint: Includes cases like a Task Manager kill, where the cause is unknown

shell.daemon_down_body: The daemon that starts and manages servers is stopped. Restarting it reloads the server list.

shell.check_log_ok: No known problems in the recent log
shell.exit_note_gave_up: Gave up after {{count}} restarts in 10 minutes
shell.parent_job_short: Core is tied to another app

shell.logs_saved_truncated: Log too long, only the latest part saved: {{path}}
shell.info_check_desc: Checks settings and files before start, finds known problems in logs, and checks whether the server is reachable from outside.
shell.delete_desc: Server files are deleted too. You are asked to confirm once more before deleting.
shell.delete_desc_linked: Removed from the list only. The server folder is kept.

discord.connect_body: Get a pairing code and enter it in your Discord server to connect. Once connected, the bot can start and stop game servers from that server.
discord.pair_step_command: Type this command in a Discord channel
discord.pair_waiting: Waiting for the command in Discord
discord.pair_not_saved: Entered in Discord, but saving the connection on this PC failed. Get a new code and connect again.
discord.invalid_relay_url: The Server-chan address must start with https://. http is allowed only for testing on this PC (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]).
discord.permission_keys_ignored: Permission settings cannot be changed here and keep their previous values. The rest was saved. Change permissions on the permissions screen.
discord.pair_error: Pairing code request failed. Check the internet connection.
discord.relay_failed_body: Server-chan connection failed ({{error}}). Refresh shortly, or reconnect if it persists.
discord.relay_rejected_title: Server-chan rejected this PC's connection key
discord.relay_rejected_body: This PC may have been reconnected from another PC in Discord, or the key changed. Reconnecting with a new code keeps Discord server settings.
discord.heartbeat_rejected_title: Server-chan rejected this PC's status report
discord.relay_rate_limited_body: Too many checks were sent in a short time. It checks again automatically shortly. No need to reconnect.
discord.pair_pick_this_pc: If Discord asks which PC to reconnect, pick this PC. Picking another PC disconnects that PC.
discord.conn_sub_paused: Connected to Discord. Command relay off
discord.agent_desc: This PC receives and runs commands sent from Discord. When off, the bot does not respond.
discord.agent_replaced: This Discord account's PC connection moved to another PC and stopped here. To use this PC again, pair again from this PC.
discord.add_server_desc: Get a new code and enter it in another Discord server to connect that server to this PC too.
discord.new_guild_instances_title: Open my servers in new Discord servers
discord.new_guild_instances_desc: Discord servers connected with a pairing code get every server on this PC right away. When off, you pick servers for each Discord server. Servers connected with /saba connect (no code) are always picked manually.
discord.disconnect_desc: Disconnects this PC from every Discord server.
discord.agent_none: No AI agent connected. Add {{url}} to an agent such as ChatGPT or Claude to let it manage the PCs of your Discord account.
discord.agent_linked: AI agent {{name}} can manage every PC of your Discord account. Last used: {{when}}
discord.agent_list_desc: Connected AI agents can manage every PC of your Discord account. Up to 10 per account. Click a card to disconnect it.
discord.erase_desc: Deletes all your Discord account data held by Server-chan and disconnects this PC. Deleted once you agree on the website.
discord.erase_waiting: Waiting for consent on the website. This PC disconnects once you agree.
discord.erase_done: Data deleted and this PC disconnected from Server-chan
discord.erase_expired: Consent expired. Press again to delete.
discord.erase_disconnect_failed: Data deleted, but removing this PC's connection info failed. Press Disconnect.
discord.iw_desc: Set the words that call this server and its commands. They work the same in every connected Discord server.
discord.iw_err_unknown_command: No such command on this server
discord.instances_mode: Instances this Discord server can use
discord.instances_pick_desc: Only instances turned on are visible and controllable in Discord
discord.no_instances: No instances. Add one on the Servers page first.
discord.members_empty: Member load failed. Check that command relay is on, then refresh.
discord.members_refresh_failed: Member list refresh failed. Showing the earlier list.
discord.members_partial: Full Discord member list unavailable. Showing only members with permissions.
discord.no_commands: No Discord commands in this module
discord.prefix_desc: The bot responds to Discord messages starting with these words, and Talking Saba-chan is called by them too. You can set several.
discord.disconnect_failed: Disconnect failed: {{error}}. The bot may still accept commands.
discord.invite_hint: If the Saba-chan bot is not in your Discord server, invite it first.
discord.channels_music_warn: All regular messages in {{channel}} will be deleted. Pick a song-only channel.
discord.channels_err_conflict: The same channel cannot be assigned to two types
discord.channels_err_unknown: {{channel}} is not a text channel the bot can use in this server
discord.channels_err_bot: Change failed: bot could not be checked. Unassigning still works.
discord.channels_err_moved: Not saved: this Discord server moved to another PC in the meantime
discord.perm_err_generic: Permission load/save failed. Check that Saba-chan is running, then refresh.
discord.perm_chatbot_cap_hint: Requests via Talking Saba-chan never exceed this level.
discord.perm_import_hint: Levels given earlier in Discord remain on Server-chan. Pick the ones to keep here.
discord.perm_owner_mismatch: Server-chan reports a different owner ({{relay}}). Here the owner stays {{owner}}. If Server-chan is right, change the owner.
discord.perm_commands_help_hint: help and list are open to everyone except banned, and cannot be changed.
discord.perm_err_invalid_ladder: Level names must be 1–32 characters. At least one level must remain between Owner and Banned. Up to 20 extra levels.
discord.perm_preset_reset: {{count}} command level(s) will be reset to the {{preset}} preset.
discord.perm_ladder_hint: Drag blocks to set the order, click a name to rename. Higher means a higher level. Owner and Banned cannot be moved; Owner, Guest and Banned cannot be deleted. To swap commands, press "Swap permissions" below and pick two levels.
discord.perm_ladder_removed: People on a deleted level move to the level just below. Commands from that level up move to the level just above.

bot_settings.big_emoji_desc: A message with only custom emoji is reposted as a large image.
bot_settings.member_notice_desc: Posts in the notice channel when a member joins or leaves the Discord server.
bot_settings.busy_notice_desc: Posts a notice in the notice channel while the PC is overloaded and removes it when resolved.
bot_settings.game_chat_guard: Block messages while chat link is off
bot_settings.game_chat_guard_desc: Removes plain messages in the game chat channel when it has no chat link. Replies to game chat lines and messages with a call word are kept.
bot_settings.game_chat_clear_on_stop: Clear chat when the server stops
bot_settings.game_chat_clear_on_stop_desc: When a server stops, its chat posted in the game chat channel while it ran is removed.
bot_settings.game_chat_auto_open: Turn chat link on when the server starts
bot_settings.game_chat_auto_open_desc: Opens the game chat channel's chat link automatically while someone is on a running server.
bot_settings.music_ui_hint: Shows the current track and queue in the Singing Saba-chan channel.
bot_settings.range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
bot_settings.not_synced: Saved. Not yet applied in Discord; applies on the next connection.
bot_settings.not_loaded: Reading this server's settings from Server-chan failed. Shown values are defaults and cannot be changed. Reload once connected.
bot_settings.confirm_desc: Before running, asks the requester again via a Discord button. Only the requester can press it. In the app, web and CLI, dangerous commands and stop/restart always ask regardless of this setting.
bot_settings.confirm_chatbot_hint: Admin tasks picked by Talking Saba-chan and requests mixing several people always ask regardless of this setting.
bot_settings.tts_volume_hint: Reading volume. Separate from music volume.
bot_settings.tts_names_desc: Says "name," before each message to identify the author.
bot_settings.tts_voice_chat_only_hint: /tts cannot be used in regular text channels. The game chat channel is the exception.
bot_settings.tts_keep_read_hint: Read messages stay in the channel instead of being deleted.
bot_settings.tts_auto_channels_desc: When 2 or more people are in a chosen voice channel, Saba-chan joins and reads every message in its chat. If several fill up, she stays in the first one. Up to 10.
bot_settings.tts_auto_channels_none: No voice channels to choose. Only voice channels the bot can see and join are listed.
bot_settings.tts_limits: Fixed limits: {{chars}} characters per message, {{perMinute}} characters per minute per person
bot_settings.sleep_desc: While asleep (/saba sleep or Good kid), the selected features are turned off. Others keep running. Mentions get only an "I'm sleeping" reply.
bot_settings.sleep_commands_hint: Server commands, start and stop alerts, status board, game chat
bot_settings.sleep_llm_hint: Chat, joining in, reminders, AI moderation. Summarizes the chat into memory when falling asleep.
bot_settings.sleep_music_hint: Music commands and the music channel
bot_settings.sleep_extras_hint: Emoji upscale, cleanup, game stats, server moderation commands and more
bot_settings.bedtime_hint: Auto sleep: sleeps and wakes at set times. /saba wake during sleep wakes it only until the next bedtime.
bot_settings.bedtime_zone: Based on this server's time zone (if unset, the time zone of the server language)

discord.prefix_default_hint: Using the default {{prefix}}. The default follows the app language.
discord.prefix_err_length: Prefixes can be up to {{max}} characters: {{words}}
discord.translate_commands_desc: Adds translated names and descriptions of game commands to Discord slash commands. When off, only the original module names (e.g. save-all) are shown.
discord.slash_desc: Set how Discord slash commands appear on this server.
discord.slash_prefix_desc: When on, commands are grouped under Saba-chan, like /saba status. When off, they are used directly, like /status, and server management commands (permission, assign, language, etc.) are visible only to people with Manage Server.
discord.slash_root_name_desc: With the server call word, each server shows as its first call word (like /pal). Servers without one use the instance name.
discord.private_queries_title: Show query results only to the caller
discord.private_queries_desc: Results only the asker needs, such as port forwarding checks, backup lists and resource usage, are shown only to them, keeping the channel tidy. Shared results such as server status and players stay visible.
discord.start_notice_hint: Servers with the bell on are announced in this Discord server's alert channel when they start or stop outside Discord (app, web, CLI, schedule, auto restart, in game, crash). Starts and stops from Discord are excluded. PC alerts such as crashes and backups go to the PC owner by DM. Set the alert channel in <link/>.
discord.full_notice_hint: Servers with the person button on post in the alert channel when full or when a slot opens again.
discord.pc_notice_desc: This PC's alerts go to the PC owner as a Discord DM. Turn on only the ones you want.
discord.dm_group_guild: Discord servers this PC is linked to
discord.dm_crash_desc: Server crash alert. If auto restart is off, a Restart button is attached.
discord.dm_crash_off_warn: When off, crashes are not reported on Discord. They still appear in app notifications.
discord.dm_unresponsive_desc: Alerts when a running server stops answering status checks. For notify-only servers, a Restart button is attached.
discord.dm_external_start_desc: Alert for a server started outside Saba-chan
discord.dm_schedule_desc: Alert a few minutes before a scheduled restart, update or stop
discord.dm_backup_desc: Backup results to send by DM
discord.dm_disk_desc: Alerts when free space on the server or backup drive falls below 10%.
discord.dm_offline_desc: Alerts when this PC cannot reach Server-chan for over 3 minutes while a game server is running, e.g. a power cut or lost internet. Not sent when you quit Saba-chan yourself or it updates.
discord.dm_chatbot_usage_desc: Alerts at 50, 80 and 100% of this month's token limit, or when the balance falls below the set amount.
discord.dm_moderation_desc: Alerts when a message looks problematic. Sent only to admins of that Discord server.
discord.perm_inherit_hint: A higher level can use every command of the lower levels.
discord.perm_add_search: Find a member to add to {{level}}
discord.perm_import_count: Import levels given earlier on Discord ({{count}})
discord.perm_moved_count: {{count}} command(s) moved away from the preset
discord.perm_fixed_hint: This command affects the whole PC, so its level cannot be changed
discord.instance_menu_hint: Click an instance to see the commands each level can use. Set member levels in <link/>.
discord.perm_people_server_wide: Member levels apply to every instance on this Discord server.

mod.no_bot: Saba-chan is not in this server or not connected. Server management unavailable
mod.no_channels: No text channels Saba-chan can see
mod.stale_hint: Some assignments remain on channels that were deleted or that Saba-chan cannot see.
mod.info_desc: Change the Discord channel name and topic
mod.name: Name
mod.rename_limit_hint: Discord allows only two name or topic changes per 10 minutes.
mod.assign_desc: Choose what Saba-chan does in this channel
mod.assign_rule: A channel does one job. Music and alerts use one channel per server, so picking one moves it from its old channel. Chat, game chat and the status board can each use up to {{max}} channels.
mod.assign_unavailable: Saba-chan cannot post in this channel, so it cannot be assigned
mod.slow_desc: Each member can post once per interval
mod.lock_desc: Nobody can post. Server admins still can
mod.auto_desc: Deletes messages past the keep time every 15 minutes. Pins and Saba-chan panels are kept
mod.author: Member
mod.clear_confirm_hint: Pins and Saba-chan panels are kept. Deleted messages cannot be restored.
mod.clear_done: {{deleted}} messages deleted. {{kept}} pins and Saba-chan panels kept
mod.clear_older_left: More messages older than 14 days remain. Clear again to continue.
mod.mute_desc: Blocks chat, reactions and voice. Removes the member from voice channels
mod.forever_note: Indefinite · Saba-chan renews it every 28 days
mod.err_BOT_MISSING_PERMISSION: Saba-chan lacks the {{permission}} permission. Grant it in Discord server settings.
mod.err_RENAME_LIMIT: Discord limit exceeded. Name and topic can be changed again in {{minutes}} min.
mod.err_BOT_UNAVAILABLE: Saba-chan bot connection failed. Try again shortly.
mod.err_NODE_MOVED: This Discord server moved to another PC in the meantime.
mod.err_MUTE_CANNOT: Cannot mute (server owner or a role above Saba-chan)
mod.err_MUTE_TOO_LONG: Maximum 28 days. Choose Indefinite for longer.

discord.perm_list_hint: For each command, pick the lowest level that can use it and whether Discord asks again. Higher levels can use every command of the levels below.
discord.perm_stairs_hint: Each command sits on the step from which it can be used. Higher steps can use every command on the steps below. Drag a chip, or click it, to move it to another step.
discord.perm_applies_to: Applies to all {{count}} instances that have this command.
discord.perm_confirm_tier_hint: Compared with the Discord confirm level to decide whether a button asks again. App and CLI confirmations are unchanged.
discord.perm_confirm_tier_mixed_hint: Instances use different tiers. Picking one sets them all to it.
discord.perm_server_wide: Server-wide command, so the change applies to every instance menu.
discord.perm_line_hint: Levels above the line can start, stop, restart and create backups. People on an instance's operators list always can.
discord.perm_swap_done: {{a}} ⇄ {{b}} · People stay as they are. Applies after saving.
discord.perm_swap_none: No commands start at this level

maintenance.backups_desc: Compresses the world and save files. Backups you make yourself are excluded from automatic pruning.
maintenance.backup_pre_restore_hint: State right before the restore · deleted automatically 15 min after the server starts
maintenance.restore_hint: The current state is backed up first.
maintenance.restored: Restored. The prior state was backed up too
maintenance.restored_links_missed: Restored, but {{count}} link(s) in the folder failed to restore (Windows permissions, etc.). See the daemon log for paths.
maintenance.err_restore_outside: Backup made for a different server folder, so it cannot be restored here. If you moved the server folder, move it back, then restore.
maintenance.err_backup_busy: Another task (backup, restore, update, etc.) is running on this server. Try again when it finishes.
maintenance.err_backups_unreadable: Backup folder read failed. Check folder permissions and disk state, then try again.
maintenance.err_schedule_changed: Not saved: the schedule was changed elsewhere. Reload, then edit.
maintenance.schedule_desc: Automatically runs server start, stop, save, backup, restart, announce, update and game commands at set times or intervals.
maintenance.schedule_date_passed: Task {{n}} has a date that has passed and will not run. Fix the date or time.
maintenance.err_every: Enter a whole number of minutes, at least 1.
maintenance.backup_unreadable_hint: Backup cannot be opened and cannot be restored. Unused backup content is not cleaned up until it is deleted, so delete it.
maintenance.err_backup_file_locked: Backup failed: the server is using a file ({{file}}). Stop the server and try again.
maintenance.err_autosave_not_resumed: Backup made, but resuming the server's autosave failed. Restart the server.
maintenance.err_backup_failed_autosave_off: Backup failed, and resuming the server's autosave failed. Restart the server.
maintenance.err_backup_save_rejected: No backup: the server refused the save command. Stop the server and back up again.
maintenance.err_backup_save_unconfirmed: No backup: the server did not report that saving finished. Try again shortly, or stop the server and back up.
maintenance.err_backup_server_stopped: The server stopped during the backup, so it was discarded. Check the server and back up again.
maintenance.backup_import_note: Importing adds it to this server's backup list. To apply it to the server, press "Restore" in the list.
maintenance.err_import_not_backup: Not a backup file exported by Saba-chan
maintenance.err_import_damaged: Backup file damaged. Export it again from the original PC.
maintenance.err_import_other_module: Backup made for a different game server. Cannot import
maintenance.err_export_old_backup: Backup made by an older version. Cannot export
maintenance.backup_keep_snapshot_hint: Keeps the game's latest automatic backup as a Saba-chan backup. Safe while the server is running.
maintenance.backup_game_snapshot: Automatic backup made by the game · restore only
maintenance.err_snapshot_not_found: No automatic backup from the game
maintenance.start_date_hint: Runs every N days counted from this date. If empty, counted from the day you save.
maintenance.err_every_days: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {{max}}.
maintenance.err_command: Pick a game command to run.
maintenance.server_clock: Times follow the server PC's clock ({{zone}}). Next runs are shown in this device's time.
maintenance.command_danger: This command is hard to undo. It runs at the set time without confirmation.
maintenance.run_code_command_failed: Server did not accept the command
maintenance.run_code_backup_unsupported: This game does not support backups
maintenance.run_code_save_unsupported: This game has no save command
maintenance.danger_confirm: Scheduling a command that is hard to undo. Press again to save.

chatbot.sync_pending: Not yet applied to some Discord servers. They sync automatically on the next connection.
chatbot.key_desc: Only this PC's daemon and Server-chan know the key. It is not shown again.
chatbot.key_replace_placeholder: Enter a new key to replace it
chatbot.key_providers: Enter a key from OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, Grok, Mistral or another major AI company, and the provider is detected and connected automatically.
chatbot.key_needed: Add a key so Talking Saba-chan can answer.
chatbot.effort_hint: How deeply Saba-chan thinks when called or in a conversation. Higher is smarter but slower and costlier. Applies to OpenAI and Claude keys only.
chatbot.memory_hint: Remembers what it learns in conversations for later ones. Memories about people are shared by every chatbot channel in this server.
chatbot.moderation_desc: When the same person floods the chat or posts promotional content such as crypto or stock tip rooms or illegal material, the AI takes a second look. If it judges the post harmful, it DMs the person and a message link only to the server owner or admins among those who connected a PC to this server. Messages are not deleted and nobody is sanctioned.
chatbot.moderation_hint: The AI is called only for suspicious posts (up to 20 per hour), billed to your registered API key.
chatbot.token_alert_desc: When usage passes the set amount, the person who connected a PC to this server gets a Discord DM.
chatbot.token_limit_hint: Input + output tokens. Alerts once each at 50, 80 and 100%. Resets monthly.
chatbot.balance_alert_hint: Alerts when the API balance falls below this amount (in the provider's currency). Only for providers that report a balance.
chatbot.alert_invalid: Enter a number of 1 or more, or leave empty.
chatbot.ambient_desc: Can occasionally read and join conversations she was not called into. Most checks end with just listening.
chatbot.ambient_hint: When off, she answers only when called.
chatbot.ambient_effort_hint: Low recommended. If she decides to speak, she thinks once more at the conversation effort before sending.
chatbot.credit_desc: Balance of the saved API key and this month's usage
chatbot.credit_balance_unsupported: {{provider}} does not report the balance for regular API keys. Check it on their website.
chatbot.credit_usage_line: {{calls}} model calls · {{input}} input tokens ({{cached}} cached) · {{output}} output tokens
chatbot.credit_guild_failed: This server could not be loaded
chatbot.credit_exhausted: Credit exhausted ({{time}}). Cannot answer until topped up.
chatbot.memo_placeholder: What Saba-chan should know about this server: tone, forms of address, mood, interests. Appended after Saba-chan's default instructions.
chatbot.relay_delete_pending: Old Talking Saba-chan settings not yet removed from Server-chan. Removal is retried on the next connection.
chatbot.channels_moved: Pick the channels Talking Saba-chan chats in at <link/>.
chatbot.models_need_key: Saving an API key loads the available models.
chatbot.models_need_guild: Connecting a Discord server loads the available models.
chatbot.models_err_NO_API_KEY: The API key has not reached the server yet. Try again shortly.
chatbot.models_err_INVALID_API_KEY: API key rejected. Check the key.
chatbot.models_err_KEY_PERMISSION: API key lacks permissions. In OpenAI, set the key to All or allow Models (read) and Responses (write).
chatbot.models_err_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Model provider connection failed. Try again shortly.
chatbot.model_fallback: The selected model ({{model}}) is unavailable, so {{fallback}} is used instead. Saving makes {{fallback}} the new model.
chatbot.tool_unavailable_operator_key: The Saba-chan server cannot use this tool right now
chatbot.tool_unavailable_provider: The current API key's provider does not support this tool
chatbot.tools_need_guild: Connecting a Discord server loads the tool list.
chatbot.guild_enabled: Use Talking Saba-chan in this server
chatbot.saba_desc: API key, model and remaining credit shared by every Discord server. Features are turned on or off per Discord server.
chatbot.model_desc: Talking Saba-chan answers with this model in every Discord server.
chatbot.prefix_calls_guild: Answers when called with a call word from <link/>.
chatbot.guild_desc: Set whether Talking Saba-chan works in this server, how she answers and which tools she uses. API key and model are set in <link/>.
chatbot.token_limit_no_balance: {{provider}} does not report remaining credit. Use this limit for alerts.
chatbot.token_limit_invalid: Enter a number above 0, or leave empty.

module_audit.title: Module '{{module}}' uses undeclared capabilities
module_audit.summary: The code uses {{perms}}, which are not in module.toml. Make sure the module is trustworthy.
module_audit.ext_summary: The code uses {{perms}}, which are not in the permissions of manifest.json. Make sure the extension is trustworthy.
module_audit.perm_stdlib_shadow: files that shadow the standard library
module_audit.unavailable: Code check failed for '{{name}}'. It is checked again on next open.

trust.verified_tip: From the official catalog and unchanged since.
trust.modified_tip: Files changed after install from the official catalog. Reinstall unless you edited them.
trust.unverified_tip: Not from the official catalog. Make sure the source is trustworthy.

notice.module_unverified: Created from a module ({{id}}) not from the official catalog. Make sure the source is trustworthy.
notice.module_modified: Files of module ({{id}}) changed after install. Reinstall unless you edited them yourself.
notice.extension_unverified: Enabled an extension ({{id}}) not from the official catalog. Make sure the source is trustworthy.
notice.extension_modified: Files of extension ({{id}}) changed after install. Reinstall unless you edited them yourself.
notice.isolated: This component's Python scripts run in an isolated environment with access to allowed folders only. The game server process is not isolated.

create_notice.unverified: This module is not from the official catalog. Its Python scripts run isolated, but the game server it installs and runs is not isolated and runs with this account's permissions. Continue only if you trust this module.
create_notice.modified: This module's files changed after install from the official catalog. Its Python scripts run isolated, but the game server it installs and runs is not isolated and runs with this account's permissions. Continue only if you trust this module.

start_blocked.launch_outside_instance: An unverified module tried to run a program outside the server folder: {{file}} If you set the Java path yourself, select it again in server settings.
start_blocked.server_folder_label: Not started: cleaning up permission marks on the server folder ({{file}}) failed. Check that this account can change that folder's permissions.
start_blocked.server_in_sync_folder: Not started: {{file}} is inside a sync folder such as OneDrive. Move the server folder outside the sync folder.
start_blocked.sandbox_unavailable: Not run: isolated environment setup failed for {{component}}
start_blocked.extension_not_verified: Extension files changed and cannot be verified: {{extensions}}. Reinstall or restore the originals.

sandbox.title: Run without isolation?
sandbox.message:
Isolated environment setup failed for {{component}}. {{detail}}

If you trust the component, you can run it without isolation. It then can access all files and the network with your account's permissions. You are asked again if its files change.
sandbox.allowed: {{component}} allowed to run without isolation. Asked again if its files change.

extension_gui.title: Load this extension's screens?
extension_gui.message: {{id}} is an unverified extension. If allowed, its screen code can control everything Saba-chan does on this PC. Allow only if it comes from a source you trust. You are asked again if its files change.

patch_notes.title: Patch notes
patch_notes.notice_success: Updated to Saba-chan {{version}}. Click to see patch notes
patch_notes.no_notes: No patch notes for this version

data_transfer.title: Move data
data_transfer.description: Saves the server list and settings to one file, or loads a file saved on another PC. Game server files are not included.
data_transfer.secrets_description: Also stores server passwords and the Discord connection token. When off, they are excluded.
data_transfer.exported_secrets: The file contains secrets, so keep it somewhere safe.
data_transfer.reason_exists: a server with the same ID exists
data_transfer.reason_working_dir_in_use: another server uses its working folder
data_transfer.reason_name_taken: a server with the same name exists
data_transfer.reason_busy: being installed, updated, backed up or restored
data_transfer.node_token_imported: Discord connection token: use the one in the file
data_transfer.node_token_kept: Discord connection token: keep the current one
data_transfer.missing_modules: Modules not on this PC: {{modules}}. Install them to run those servers.
data_transfer.overwrite_description: Replaces servers that already exist with the file's contents. Running servers are not replaced.
data_transfer.err_invalid_archive: Not a Saba-chan export file, or damaged
data_transfer.err_write_failed: File write failed. Check the location and permissions.
data_transfer.restart_hint: Imported app settings apply after restarting Saba-chan.

monitor.title: System monitor
monitor.unavailable: No data received from the daemon
monitor.network_note: Whole-machine traffic, not split by instance · relative to the 2-minute peak
monitor.footnote: Disk IO and network are whole-PC values, not split per server. Rings are relative to the 2-minute peak.
monitor.disk_io_note: Whole-PC physical disk value, not split per server · relative to the 2-minute peak
monitor.disk_io_process_note: Physical disk values unavailable; showing the sum of process IO (includes cache)
monitor.net_trace_needs_grant: Per-port/server network permission missing · grant it in Settings > Game servers
monitor.net_trace_needs_relogin: Sign in to Windows again to count per server
monitor.net_trace_error: Network events unreadable; showing total traffic only
monitor.hidden_toast: System monitor off. Turn it back on in Settings → General.

net_trace.label: Per-server and per-port network
net_trace.description: While the system monitor is expanded, counts traffic per server and port from Windows network events. Needs administrator confirmation once at first.
net_trace.status_ok: Permission granted. Counting starts when the monitor is expanded.
net_trace.status_needs_grant: This account has no permission to read network events
net_trace.status_needs_relogin: Permission granted. Sign in to Windows again to start counting.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.desc_server: Who did what to this server, when and from where. Newest first.
audit.desc_all: Who did what to every server, when and from where. Newest first.
audit.upcoming_desc: Scheduled tasks across all servers on this PC. Each task shows only its next run. Click a row to open that server's Backups & schedule tab.
audit.upcoming_clash: {{actions}} overlap at {{time}}. Running at once on the same PC may slow things down.
audit.http_409: Not possible in the current state
audit.code_server_running: Not possible while the server is running
audit.code_no_command_path: Server started outside Saba-chan, so commands cannot be sent
audit.code_backup_busy: Another task (backup, restore, update) in progress
audit.code_instance_busy: Another task (backup, restore, update) in progress

launch_preview.title: Launch arguments preview
launch_preview.unknown_args: Arguments with no matching setting are passed as is: {{args}}
launch_preview.unchecked: Not saved: extra arguments could not be checked

saba.sleep_body: Saba-chan is asleep, so the servers can't be shown. Wake her up and she'll be right there.
saba.sleepy: Yawn… I'm up. What's going on…?
saba.recovering: {{name}} fell over! Getting it back on its feet…
saba.stopped: Couldn't get {{name}} back up… Please check on it.
saba.slow_progress: This is taking a while. It hasn't stopped!

activity.idle: Click to view the daemon console log

palette.title: Sonar
palette.placeholder: What do you want to do? Server names also work
palette.empty_hint: Game commands of servers that are off or can't take commands aren't shown.

control_desc.restart: Stops the server and starts it again.
control_desc.backup: Saves the current state as a backup.

palette.no_inputs_hint: Sends right away, nothing to fill in.
palette.pv_scope: Press Enter to focus on this one and show only what you can do there.
palette.pv_switch: Press Enter to switch to {{name}} and keep filling in this command.
palette.pv_setting: Opens that screen, then finds and highlights this setting.
palette.pv_jump: Opens this screen without running anything.
palette.commands_none: No commands can be sent now
palette.arg_skip: Leave it empty and press Enter to skip.
palette.danger_warn: This is a dangerous command. Confirm once more.

unisolated.title: Run without isolation
unisolated.description: Components set to run without isolation because the isolated environment could not be prepared. They can access all files and the network with your account's permissions.
unisolated.stale: Files changed after you agreed, so this consent is not used. You are asked again on the next run.
unisolated.revoked: Consent to run {{component}} without isolation removed

extension_gui_consent.title: Extension screens
extension_gui_consent.description: Unverified extensions whose screens you allowed to load. Allowed screen code can control everything Saba-chan does on this PC.
extension_gui_consent.stale: Files changed after you allowed it, so this permission is not used. You are asked again next time it is enabled.
extension_gui_consent.pending: Waiting for permission. Screens are not loaded until you allow them.
extension_gui_consent.allow_named: Allow the screens of the {{id}} extension
extension_gui_consent.revoked: Screen permission for {{component}} removed. Applies from the next launch.

events.server_update: {{name}}: new game server version released. Update the server if players cannot join.
events.server_update_waiting: {{name}}: new game server version released. {{count}} player(s) online, auto update waiting
events.server_update_waiting_unknown: {{name}}: new game server version released. Players online, auto update waiting
events.server_update_scheduled: {{name}}: warned in game. Update in {{minutes}} min.
events.instance_started_external: '{{name}}' started outside Saba-chan. Saba-chan did not start this process.

memory_limit.title: Memory limit
memory_limit.desc: Limits the memory the server and its child processes can use together. The server is stopped if exceeded.
memory_limit.label: Memory limit (MB)
memory_limit.hint: Empty means no limit. For Java servers, set it 1–2 GB above the -Xmx value. Windows only.
memory_limit.hint_locked: Empty means no limit. For Java servers, set it 1–2 GB above the -Xmx value.
memory_limit.unsupported: Memory limits apply only on Windows. The PC running this server is not Windows, so the limit was not saved.
memory_limit.locked: The PC running this server is not Windows, so a memory limit cannot be used.
memory_limit.stale: Previously saved value, not applied now. The PC running this server is not Windows, so a memory limit cannot be enforced.

game_chat.title: Game chat relay
game_chat.desc: Sends in-game chat to the game chat channel on Discord. Discord messages are not sent into the game.
game_chat.mode_keyword: Only chat starting with the keyword
game_chat.keyword_hint: Chat starting with this word is sent without it. One word, up to 32 characters.
game_chat.channel_note: Assign the channel as Game chat in <link/>, or with /saba assign.

access.applies_all: The mode and lists apply to every linked Discord server.
access.title: Usage mode
access.shared_desc: Follows the Discord server's level permissions. Each member can start, stop and send commands as far as their level allows.
access.members_desc: Independent of Discord server permissions. Only people on the dedicated member list can control this server and use every command.

kick.title: Auto kick
kick.desc: Nicknames listed here are kicked as soon as they join the game. Not banned.
kick.unsupported: This server cannot read joins, so auto kick is unavailable

branch.desc: Creates a new server under '{{name}}'. Server folder, world and port are separate, and current settings are copied once. After that, each server is managed separately.
branch.name: Name
branch.port_auto: A free port is picked on creation

players.title: Player lists
players.desc: Adding or removing a name applies to the running server immediately.
players.desc_offline: Current list. Names can be added or removed while the server is running.

controllers.desc: People on this list can start and stop this server and use every command. Discord levels are not checked.
controllers.members_hint: If no Discord members show, open the server once on the Discord screen.
controllers.note: Only people with a linked Discord account can use this server from Discord. Nickname-only entries are who may join while auto kick is on.
controllers.err_too_many: Up to 200 people on the list
controllers.err_gate_on: To empty the list, first turn off "Auto kick people not on the list".

controllers_only.label: Auto kick people not on the list
controllers_only.hint: Only the nickname is checked, so anyone joining with a listed nickname gets in. In games where players choose their own name, or on servers with account verification off, anyone can use that name.
controllers_only.empty: Add at least one member to turn this on.

stop_timeout.title: Stop wait time
stop_timeout.desc: After asking the server to save and stop, Saba-chan waits this long, then force-kills it if it has not stopped. Raise it for large worlds.
stop_timeout.label: Stop wait (seconds)
stop_timeout.hint: 1 to 3600 seconds. Empty uses the game default.

loading.failed_hint: If you open anyway, only the interface opens. Restart the daemon to manage servers.

agreements.title: Agreements
agreements.start_message: To start '{{name}}', agree to the terms below. Read them and check each one.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Shows daemon state and recent warnings. Copy it when asking about a problem. Passwords and tokens are not included.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.desc_module: Get game modules from Saba Storage.
onboarding.desc_server: Import an existing server or create a new one.
onboarding.desc_discord: Link the bot to this PC in the Discord tab.
onboarding.desc_chatbot: Add an AI key to manage servers in plain language.
onboarding.desc_start: Pick a server and press Start.

folder_paths.title: Folders
folder_paths.description: Where Saba-chan keeps its files. Modules and extensions can be moved with their installed files to another folder. All servers must be stopped.
folder_paths.confirm_modules: Move modules to the modules folder in {{dir}}?
folder_paths.confirm_extensions: Move extensions to the extensions folder in {{dir}}?
folder_paths.left_behind: Could not delete these old files. Delete them yourself: {{files}}
folder_paths.err_busy: An install, update, backup or other task is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
folder_paths.err_env_fixed: Folder fixed by an environment variable ({{detail}})
folder_paths.err_not_absolute: Choose a folder by its full path.
folder_paths.err_root_or_home: Choose a folder inside a drive or user folder, not the drive or user folder itself.
folder_paths.err_contains_data_dir: That folder contains the Saba-chan data folder. Choose another.
folder_paths.err_overlaps_current: That folder is inside the current folder or contains it. Choose another.
folder_paths.err_overlaps_other: Overlaps the modules or extensions folder. Choose another.
folder_paths.err_not_empty: That location already has files: {{detail}}. Choose an empty one.
folder_paths.err_has_link: The folder contains a link ({{detail}}). Remove it, then try again.
folder_paths.err_copy_failed: Copy failed. Nothing changed. Check free space and try again.
folder_paths.err_acl_failed: Setting access permissions on the new folder failed. Nothing changed. Choose another folder.
folder_paths.err_verify_failed: Not moved: the copy differs from the original. Nothing changed. Try again.
folder_paths.err_commit_failed: Setting save failed. Files were put back in place.
folder_paths.err_overlaps_install: Cannot be placed inside the Saba-chan install folder. Choose a folder outside it.

update_required.title: Update required
update_required.relay: Update required. Server-chan requires Saba-chan {{version}} or later.
update_required.module: Update required. The {{name}} module requires Saba-chan {{version}} or later.
update_required.module_newer: Update required. The {{name}} module requires a newer Saba-chan.
update_required.extension: Update required. The {{name}} extension requires Saba-chan {{version}} or later.

desktop_overlay.setting_description: Shows the small windows extensions place in a corner of the desktop (such as a desktop pet). Drag to move.

autostart.label: Start at sign-in
autostart.description: Starts Saba-chan when you sign in to this PC. Daemon only runs in the tray without a window.
autostart.err_gui_missing: GUI not installed, so GUI and daemon cannot be chosen
autostart.err_unsupported: Not yet available on this OS

remote_daemon.title: Remote daemon
remote_daemon.description: Manage servers on your other PCs from this PC, or let your other PCs manage this one. Only PCs connected to the same Discord account can pair.
remote_daemon.enabled_description: Your other PCs connect directly to this daemon over an encrypted connection.
remote_daemon.status_published: Your other PCs notified of this PC
remote_daemon.peers_need_relay: This PC is not connected to Discord. Connect it on the Discord page first.
remote_daemon.err_invalid_address: Enter a host name or IP address
remote_daemon.err_remote_no_endpoint: That PC is not open for remote connections
remote_daemon.err_remote_unreachable: Remote daemon connection failed. Check that the PC is on and Saba-chan is running.
remote_daemon.err_remote_rejected: Remote daemon refused the connection. Try again.
remote_daemon.err_remote_unknown: Remote daemon not connected. Connect it again.
remote_daemon.err_relay_not_paired: This PC is not connected to Discord
remote_daemon.err_remote_timeout: Remote daemon response timed out. The request may still be processing.
remote_daemon.err_remote_ambiguous: Multiple remote daemons share that name
remote_daemon.err_remote_bad_path: Path cannot be sent to a remote daemon
remote_daemon.err_remote_unauthorized: Remote daemon rejected this PC. Connect it again.
remote_daemon.err_remote_local_only: Must be done on that PC itself
remote_daemon.err_remote_field_blocked: Settings that must be changed on that PC itself: {{fields}}
remote_daemon.view_description: Combined view shows servers of other daemons (including this PC) under the chosen daemon's servers, grouped by daemon, and lets you start and stop them directly.
remote_daemon.my_pcs_description: PCs connected to the same Discord account. The starred PC is shown first when the app opens.
remote_daemon.update_started: Update started. The daemon on that PC restarts when it finishes.
remote_daemon.remove_forget_desc: Removes it from this PC's remote daemon list.
remote_daemon.remove_uninstall: Also uninstall Saba-chan on that PC
remote_daemon.remove_uninstall_desc: Stops the daemon and uninstalls the program. Running game servers are stopped too.
remote_daemon.remove_uninstall_unavailable: Only for an online Linux or Mac PC
remote_daemon.remove_relay_desc: Disconnects it from Discord on Server-chan. Other PCs no longer see it, and it must be connected again to use.
remote_daemon.install_description: Connects through this PC's ssh, installs Saba-chan and links it to this app. Saba-chan does not store keys or passwords.
remote_daemon.install_need_fields: Enter the address, account and port (1–65535)
remote_daemon.prompt_host_key: First connection to this PC. Is the fingerprint below that PC's?
remote_daemon.install_fallback: Paste this line on that PC, then enter the pairing code it shows below.
remote_daemon.err_pair_code_not_found: Pairing code not found. Check the code.
remote_daemon.err_pair_code_expired: Pairing code expired. Get a new one on that PC.
remote_daemon.err_remote_not_ready: Code received, but that PC's remote port is not open yet. Connect from its card shortly.
remote_daemon.err_ssh_missing: ssh not found on this PC. Install the OpenSSH client.
remote_daemon.err_ssh_failed: ssh connection failed. Check the address, account and password.
remote_daemon.err_pair_code_missing: Install finished but no pairing code appeared
remote_daemon.err_unsupported: Remote uninstall unavailable for that PC (Windows)
remote_daemon.err_cli_missing: Uninstall failed: saba-chan-cli not found on that PC
remote_daemon.err_remote_uninstall_failed: Saba-chan uninstall failed on that PC
remote_daemon.err_invalid_host: Enter the address as a host name or IP

other_daemons.agreement_where: Consent is recorded on the daemon of {{pc}}.
other_daemons.open_to_continue: Consent recording failed on {{pc}}. Open that daemon with "Open this daemon", then start the server.

remote_picker.title_file: Choose a file on the remote PC
remote_picker.title_folder: Choose a folder on the remote PC
remote_picker.truncated: Too many items; showing the first 5000
remote_picker.exists: {{name}} already exists. Press again to replace it.

port_check.address: Public IP {{address}} (friends join with this address and port)

verdict.unknown: Some ports could not be checked
verdict.no_ports: No port information to check for this game
verdict.host_mismatch: Public address does not point to this PC

hint.closed: Check that the router forwards this port to this PC and the PC firewall allows it.
hint.firewall: Windows Firewall blocks incoming connections on this port. For the network you are connected to now (private or public), allow saba-core if the server is stopped, or the game server program if it is running, in Windows Firewall settings, then check again.
hint.firewall_macos: The macOS firewall blocks incoming connections for this server program. In System Settings › Network › Firewall › Options, set saba-core (if the server is stopped) or the game server program such as java (if running) to Allow incoming connections, then check again.
hint.router: The PC firewall allows this port. Forward this port to this PC in your router settings, then check again.
hint.cgnat: Your provider shares one public IP among many homes, so port forwarding cannot open it. Ask your provider for a public IP or use a VPN such as Tailscale.
hint.unknown: UDP ports of a running server and ports used by other programs cannot be checked. Stop the server and check again.
hint.host_mismatch: In your domain settings, point the A record to this PC's public IP. For DDNS, check that the updater is running. If a CDN proxy is on, turn it off; game connections cannot pass through it.
hint.host_unresolved: Check the spelling of the public address and the domain's DNS settings. If the domain is new, check again shortly.

error.node_token_missing: Connect to Discord (pairing) first. Server-chan performs the check.
error.rate_limited: Too many checks. Try again in 1 minute.
error.relay_unreachable: Server-chan connection failed. Check the internet connection.

links.server_missing: Server not found. Opened the server list instead.
links.guild_missing: That Discord server is not connected. Opened the connection screen instead.
links.pick_guild: Several Discord servers connected. Pick one on the left.
links.tab_missing: That tab is unavailable now. Opened this screen instead.

command_syntax.ready: Ready to send. Press Enter to send.
command_syntax.unknown: Not in the module's command list. Sent to the server exactly as typed.
command_syntax.too_many: This command takes no arguments. Extra: {{value}}

guides.title: Guides
guides.closed_toast: Guide closed. Reopen it from the Guides card.
guides.fork_body: Do you already run a game server?
guides.import_desc: Keep your worlds, plugins, mods and settings and manage them with Saba-chan. Files can stay where they are.
guides.new_desc: Pick a game and Saba-chan downloads and installs the server files.
guides.fork_note: Have several? Import them one at a time. You can also do this later via Add server.
guides.modules_body: A module is a small file describing how Saba-chan installs, starts and configures a game server.
guides.modules_load_failed: Module list load failed. Try again from Saba Storage.
guides.module_failed: Module install failed. Try again from Saba Storage.
guides.modules_more: Find other games in Saba Storage.
guides.start_coach: Press Start to start the server

public_address.label: Game server address
public_address.auto_desc: Uses this PC's IP as seen by Server-chan. Home internet IPs change occasionally.
public_address.auto_desc_ip: Uses this PC's IP as seen by Server-chan, currently {{ip}}. Home internet IPs change occasionally.
public_address.custom_desc: Enter a domain (DDNS works too) or a fixed IP. Each server adds its own port. Remote daemon connections use this address too.
public_address.preview: Friends see it like {{example}}. https:// and :port are removed on save.
public_address.share_desc: When off, /address in Discord does not show this PC's server addresses. The app, CLI and Saba-chan web still show them.
public_address.err_invalid: Only a domain or IP address is allowed

server_address.title: Join address
server_address.unknown: This PC's public address is unknown. It appears once connected to Server-chan.
server_address.stopped: Start the server so friends can join

pc_settings.address_unavailable: Changeable while that PC is on and connected
pc_settings.update_desc: Updates Saba-chan on that PC to the same version as this PC.
pc_settings.remove_desc: Disconnects it and removes it from the list. Choose what to delete in the next window.
